scope: Pure catalogue types; no Race RPC, admission or persistence contract yet.

goals.description: Complete the traditional underground Gold/Greed ending after the other goals.
goals.value: sticky boolean; other endings do not count

goals.description: Collect distinct Orbs of True Knowledge in the admitted race world.
goals.value: distinct canonical orb IDs, including verified world offsets; never a client-supplied total

goals.description: Confirm final defeats of distinct supported boss types.
goals.value: distinct boss-type IDs; phases and Parallel World repeats never add another type

goals.description: Defeat every selected boss; other bosses cannot substitute.
goals.value: all-of selected IDs; each first accepted defeat time is retained

goals.description: Enter the selected verified biome with the player in any world.
goals.value: sticky visit; camera location and merely adjacent regions do not count

goals.description: Enter the selected direction and numbered Parallel World region.
goals.value: furthest verified entered region separately east/west; higher same-direction index satisfies lower

goals.description: Reach the threshold of maximum HP, in displayed HP units.
goals.value: high-water maximum HP; current HP damage is irrelevant; completion survives max-HP loss

goals.description: Hold the required wallet balance at one time.
goals.value: wallet high-water; spending does not undo completion; deposits/withdrawals and lifetime sums are not observations
